sample.name: Reed-cutter
sample.description: A working blade with a bill-hook curve near the tip, made for standing water and used on people since. The grip is bound with the same twine the fish-weirs use.

sample.name: Warden-issue sabre
sample.description: Legion pattern, made in Gideon under contract and stamped on the ricasso. The stamp is the valuable part; the steel is ordinary and rusts in a week if you do not oil it.

sample.name: Hooked gutting knife
sample.description: Short, hooked, and worn thin on one side from being sharpened wrong for years. Every household on the Lilmoth waterfront has one and nobody would call it a weapon.
